structures.name: Empty book
structures.hint: No chapters, no notes. You build it all.

structures.name: Three acts
structures.hint: Beginning, middle and end, with the turns that carry a novel.

parts.title: Beginning
chapters: The main character in their everyday life, and what is missing there.
Something happens that cannot be ignored.
The main character chooses to take it on.

parts.title: Middle
chapters: A new situation, new friends and new enemies.
Everything turns: a revelation or a false victory.
The opposition grows and every mistake costs more.
The lowest point. The goal seems impossible.

parts.title: End
chapters: The main character understands what really has to be done.
How the world and the main character have changed.

structures.name: Three acts with an inner journey
structures.hint: What happens outside, and what the main character learns inside: the inner journey carries the story.

parts.title: The lie
chapters: The ordinary world and the lie
Outside: life as it is. Inside: the false belief that rules the main character.
Outside: something upsets everyday life. Inside: the lie is challenged for the first time.
Outside: the main character hesitates. Inside: fear clings to the lie.
Outside: the decision to act. Inside: a first doubt.

parts.title: The struggle
chapters: Outside: the goal is chased the wrong way. Inside: the lie still rules the choices.
Outside: a turn. Inside: the truth is glimpsed for the first time.
Outside: the obstacles grow. Inside: lie and truth fight over the main character.
Outside: everything seems lost. Inside: the lie has to die.

parts.title: The truth
chapters: Outside: the main character acts on the truth. Inside: the change happens.
Outside: the goal is reached, or let go. Inside: the main character is someone else now.

structures.name: Fifteen beats
structures.hint: Fifteen beats, each in its place in the book, in percent.

chapters: 1%. A picture of life before the change.
5%. Someone says, without knowing it, what the book is about.
1–10%. The main character, the world and what needs to change.
10%. The event that sets everything in motion.
22%. A new person or relationship that carries the theme.
20–50%. The promise of the premise, what the reader came for.
50%. A false victory or a false defeat. The stakes rise.
75%. The lowest point, often with a whiff of death.
75–80%. The main character takes in the loss.
80%. The solution, thanks to the B story.
80–99%. The plan is carried out, and rethought.
99–100%. The mirror of the opening image: this is how everything changed.

structures.name: The hero's journey
structures.hint: Twelve steps from home and back, for fantasy and adventure.

parts.title: Departure
chapters: The hero at home, before the adventure.
A problem or a challenge appears.
The hero hesitates before the unknown.
Someone gives advice, courage or a gift.

parts.title: Initiation
chapters: The rules of the new world are learned.
The hero faces their greatest fear.
Something is won, at a price.

parts.title: Return
chapters: The consequences chase the hero home.
A last test where everything is at stake.
The hero comes home changed, with something to give.

structures.name: Short story
structures.hint: Five short steps for a story of a few thousand words: start late, one conflict, few characters.

chapters: A first sentence or image that raises a question.
What the main character wants, and what stands in the way.

pieces.name: Two narrators
pieces.hint: A label for each voice, so it shows whose chapter it is.

pieces.name: Literary novel
pieces.hint: Themes and motifs that recur through the book.

pieces.name: Facts and sources
pieces.hint: The sources, the quotations and what needs evidence.

pieces.name: Series
pieces.hint: Threads that run between the books, and a last chapter that leads on.
chapters: A new threat or a secret that leads to the next book.
